chapter_title: [C]oncerning the Father of Gr[eat]ness: [ho]w he is established and determined.
chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely oldest-layer substrate. It presents a systematic five-fold emanation teaching: the Father of Greatness established in his five light limbs (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration = the storehouses), his twelve wisdoms, and the five great springs that gush forth from him (light, perfume, living voice, [lacuna], glory). Both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic system. There is zero editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation vocabulary. The only non-substrate material is the formulaic dialogue opening (¶1) and a minor audience reference in ¶2. Heavy lacunae throughout, especially in ¶¶7-8, but the five-fold enumeration structure is clear. Teaching purity 1.000 confirms the dominance of the oldest layer.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic dialogue frame: 'Once again the apostle speaks to his disciples' plus 'Hear this lesson that I will recount to you.' No cosmological content whatsoever. Standard session-opening formula.

paragraphs.core_text: Very great is [land of] light [...] due to the first Father of Greatness. How he ex[ists and is] established in his five light limbs, which are [ ... the store]houses that have neither limit nor measure to the[m ... ] mind, thought, insight, counsel and [consideration ... ] his twelve light limbs that are his twelve wisdoms.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'in the presence of they who will hear and know it' — audience-directed pedagogical framing that addresses potential hearers rather than describing cosmic structure.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core content is systematic cosmological mapping: Father of Greatness → five light limbs → storehouses (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration) → twelve wisdoms. This is the classic five-faculty/twelve-wisdom degree structure. The audience reference ('they who will hear and know it') is a minor pedagogical insertion. High substrate score (19.12) confirms.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, there are five great light lim[bs] in each one [ ... ] five grea[t] springs of praise gush for[th ... ] five great [ ... ] lig[ht ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Introduces the five springs/qualities that gush forth from the five limbs. This is the structural pivot that sets up the five-fold enumeration to follow. 'Springs of praise gush forth' — emanation vocabulary mapping limbs to springs. Both sides stay within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is his light that enlig[htens ... ] it gushed forth from him and pour[ed ... ] a[l]] aeons.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration unit: light → enlightens → gushes forth → pours through all aeons. Classic emanation language. Enumeration marker 'The first is' preserved as structural element of the teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is the perfume of the [ ... ] and pervades all the aeons of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration unit: perfume → pervades all aeons. Sensory correspondence (olfactory) mapped to cosmic pervasion. Substrate score 17.65 from 'aeons of greatness.' The five senses often correspond to the five limbs/springs in this tradition.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is his living voice of [ ... ... ] all his aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration unit: living voice → aeons. Auditory correspondence. Despite heavy lacunae, the enumeration structure is clear. 'Living voice' recurs in ¶8, confirming it as a technical cosmological term in this teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is his [ ... ]-ness [ ... ] gushes forth from him [ ... o]ut [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth enumeration unit: heavily damaged but preserves the enumeration marker and the 'gushes forth' emanation formula consistent with the other four units. The lost quality name would complete the five-fold sensory-cosmic mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.65⟩ The fif[th] is his great glorio[us ... ] that [ ... , w]hich [has been ma]nifested all the tim[e], whi[ch contin]ues [ ... ] all of them. It was sculpted in them [ ... ] sealed in the [m ... ] sealed [ ... ] as they send [ ... ] in [ ... ... ] they too receive nourishment [ ... ] immediately [ ... his] living voi[ce ... ] joy [ ... ] set up anew. It shall gush forth from it [ ... ] they shall [ ... ] and become rich in the [ ... ] too is beautiful [ ... ] portray[al ... ] adornment [ ... ] and they live [ ... ... ] for ev[e]r.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth and final enumeration unit: glory/splendor. This is the longest unit, elaborating the fifth spring with process vocabulary: sculpted, sealed, nourishment, gushing forth, beauty, portrayal, adornment, living forever. All describe cosmic processes within the aeons — both sides remain in the cosmic system. 'For ever' describes the eternal nature of the aeons, not an eschatological promise to an audience. Despite heavy lacunae, the substrate character is unmistakable.
